text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs joint meeting of members of the Revolutionary Command Council and leaders of the ruling Baath party
- France renews concern over Iraq's territorial integrity
- Iraq takes part in trade fair in Tunisia
- U.S. working to strip North Korea of ballistic missile capability
- Baghdad electricity board launches campaign to repair power network in the capital
- Egypt rejects normalisation of cultural ties with Israel
- Boutros-Ghali backs Germany in drive to gain permanent seat at U.N. Security Council
- National Assembly members meet minister of industry and minerals
(The above were also carried by AL-THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- U.N.'s Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO) in Iraq urges world countries to free Iraq's frozen assets
